name: The Gold Bond Group Ltd.
summary: The Gold Bond Group Ltd. engages in the storage, conveyance, and logistical solutions for cargoes and containers. It operates through five segments: FCL Terminal Activity; LCL Terminal Activity; Free Activity; E-Commerce; and Others. The company offers terminal services and warehousing of full containers for import and export, including refrigerated containers and empty containers. It also provides receiving full containers, unloading, and emptying the containers services; and splitting the cargo to customers. In addition, it operates advanced robotic logistics center that offers logistics services to companies and entities operating in online commerce. The company was formerly known as H.M.…
